author: Arnav
problem: Read a 2 by 2 grid of '#' (black) and '.' (white) with at least one black square. Print Yes if all the black squares are connected through squares that share a side, otherwise No.
bug_description: Compares against the wrong patterns: '.#.#' and '#.#.' are vertical pairs (connected), while the real No cases, the diagonals '.##.' and '#..#', print Yes.

comments.accurate: Only the two diagonal layouts leave the black squares disconnected; every other grid prints Yes
comments.wrong_behavior: Answers No when the two black squares share a column, since a 2-row grid can't link them sideways
comments.wrong_location: Pattern strings verified; check the two rows are joined in the right order
